title: bind left open (redis) — review required
description: bind runs with an open setting: binds+0.0.0.0. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply loopback bind plus requirepass and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
